summary: Frontend-only verification of Batch 2 UX fixes in the legacy /cto/tasks manual-ship flow (double-confirm removal, LiveTaskPopup reposition, Retry visual feedback). Combined code review + live UI probe on the preview environment (test@aurem.dev). All three fixes are implemented correctly and the two that can be observed without a running legacy task were verified live.

verified_fixes.fix: One-click Ship via CTO (no ShipConfirmModal double-confirm)
verified_fixes.how_verified: Code review of MessageBubble.jsx shipViaCTO() (lines 551-612): the window.dispatchEvent('aurem:open-ship-modal', ...) call has been removed and replaced with `await doSubmit().catch(...)`. doSubmit() posts directly to /cto/tasks/submit and sets shipState to 'shipping' → 'shipped' inline. grep of the codebase confirms the only remaining dispatchers of 'aurem:open-ship-modal' are (a) ShipConfirmModal's own comment/docstring, (b) Dashboard mount comment, (c) ChatPanel.jsx line 3514 which is the LOOP-mode failed-ship path only (kind='failed', state==='failed' && phase==='ship'), NOT the manual-ship path. Runtime probe on dashboard confirmed no ShipConfirmModal DOM node was created during normal chat load.

verified_fixes.fix: LiveTaskPopup repositioned to bottom-left (no longer overlaps Advisor toggle)
verified_fixes.how_verified: Runtime probe: dispatched window CustomEvent('ora-task-handoff', {task_id:'fake-...'}) on the live dashboard, popup mounted, measured bounding box: x=24, y=838, width=380, height=145 with inline style {left:'24px', bottom:'96px', right:'', top:''}. Advisor open-toggle (data-testid=ds2-advisor-open) measured at x=1894-1920, y=492-588. Both x AND y intervals are disjoint — no visual collision possible. Screenshot (live_popup_and_advisor.png) shows popup bottom-left and Advisor panel opening fully on the right without overlap.

verified_fixes.fix: Retry visual feedback (FailedCard.retry now opens LiveTaskPopup for new task)
verified_fixes.how_verified: Code review across the full prop chain: (1) TaskProgressCard.jsx FailedCard.retry() captures r.data.task_id and calls onOpenLivePopup?.(newTaskId) (lines 46-47). (2) TaskProgressCard forwards onOpenLivePopup to FailedCard (line 212). (3) ShipDialog.jsx accepts onOpenLivePopup prop (line 35) and forwards to inline TaskProgressCard (line 71). (4) MessageBubble.jsx destructures onOpenLivePopup (line 355) and passes it into ShipDialog (line 1110) and any standalone TaskProgressCard (line 1132). (5) ChatPanel.jsx line 4471 wires onOpenLivePopup={setLivePopupTaskId} into <MessageBubble>. (6) LiveTaskPopup consumes livePopupTaskId via key/taskId at line 5535. Chain is complete and correct. Runtime E2E of the retry path was not possible in this iteration because no FAILED /cto/tasks task existed for the test project and the current project's GitHub App access is revoked so a new legacy task cannot be created via the UI.

verified_fixes.fix: REGRESSION: Advisor toggle still opens Advisor panel
verified_fixes.how_verified: Clicked data-testid=ds2-advisor-open — ds2-advisor-real panel (offsetWidth=300) became visible with Morning brief, Diagnose failed run chip, Summarize open PRs chip, Token breakdown chip, advisor input, and send button all mounted and visible. Working correctly.

action_items: Nothing blocking. If founder wants a live Retry demo verified, seed a fake failed doc in db.cto_projects.<pid>.tasks with status='failed' or point the preview project at a repo where the GitHub App is actually installed so a real task can be submitted and forced to fail; the prop chain is already wired end-to-end so the popup should open automatically on retry.
critical_code_review_comments: MessageBubble.jsx is ~1224 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline ceiling; consider extracting the ship subsystem (shipViaCTO, shipState, ShipDialog wiring) into its own module in a future pass. Not blocking.

LiveTaskPopup uses fixed left:24 which is fine on desktop, but on very narrow tablets (<420px) the popup will overlap the sidebar rail (22px) — width formula min(380, 100vw-48) already handles overflow, but visually it will sit ON TOP of the collapsed sidebar rail. Acceptable trade-off given the fix intent (avoid Advisor).

ChatPanel.jsx adds paddingRight:392 to something when livePopupTaskId is truthy (line 4167) — this used to be to reserve space for the right-anchored popup. With the popup now left-anchored, that padding reservation may be unnecessary and produce a wide empty gutter while a task runs. Worth double-checking, but purely cosmetic.

In FailedCard.retry(), if r.data.task_id is missing the popup silently doesn't open — the toast still says 'Re-queued' which could re-create the exact bug the fix addresses. Recommend also toasting 'Started' / logging when task_id is absent so QA can detect API regressions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 2 (double-confirm, popup reposition, retry feedback) is implemented correctly. Two out of three fixes verified live; the retry one is code-review-verified only because the preview test project (aurem-demo/frontend) has revoked GitHub App access so no new legacy /cto/tasks task can be submitted from the UI. If retry needs live verification, either (a) restore GitHub App on the preview repo, or (b) directly insert a status='failed' task doc into the tasks collection for the active project and reload the chat to render its FailedCard, then click ↻ Retry — the LiveTaskPopup should mount with the new task_id from the retry response. Also note: ChatPanel line 4167's paddingRight:392 reservation may be a leftover from the old right-anchored popup and could be removed/repurposed.
